extracted.name: Sweet potato jacket with Coronation chickpeas
extracted.description: Transform a baked sweet potato with this tasty Coronation chickpeas topper. It's super-simple to prep and delivers two of your 5-a-day
ingredient_lines: ½ lime juiced, plus extra wedges to serve
½ small red onion thinly sliced
instruction_lines: Drain the chickpeas and mix with the yogurt, mango chutney, curry powder, a good squeeze of lime juice and some seasoning. Split the baked sweet potatoes, then fill with the yogurt mixture and top with the red onion, coriander and nigella seeds. Serve with a wedge of lime on the side.
